newsitem.title: USA: Kodak names Keegan unit president.
newsitem.headline: Kodak names Keegan unit president.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co said Monday that Richard Pignataro, president of Kodak Professional, will retire later this year and that company has named Robert Keegan to replace Pignataro effective July 7.
Kodak Professional, the company's second largest business, serves the needs of professional and commercial photographers as well as the printing and publishing industries.

Keegan, who will report to Daniel Carp, Kodak's president and chief operating officer, had been executive vice president and global strategy officer for Avery Dennison Corp, a position he assumed in 1995 after leaving Kodak.
Keegan initially joined Kodak in 1972, and held a number of finance, distribution, marketing and general management positions over 23 years.
